scope: Source anomalies, G-single, register lost updates, effective list witnesses, fixed-runtime boundary checks and deterministic concurrent-link correction probes. Full regression, database, fresh consumers, CI and public installation are separate evidence.

knownCorrectedTestHarnessIssue.cause: structuredClone preserves aliases; all synthetic group rows shared one candidateRuntimeFiles object, so changing one changed all seven. The generator now gives each group a separate map. Semantic rejection assertion was preserved.

codeReviewNotes: G-single searches only one item RW seed plus WW/WR return path; the independent two-RW and realtime-only controls do not refute it.
Register direct-RW adaptation preserves immediate successor and external-first semantics; own-read and own-successor controls remain G1c without false G2-item/G-single.
Lost-update/source-inspection profiles keep distinct algorithms, independently authorized budgets, raw identities and final effects; they do not certify isolation models or dirty-update support.

Effective list graph remains explicit; original default stays unchanged. Own pre-rollback deliveries, duplicate business values, contradictory item orders and transaction-block cycles retain the independently checked distinctions.

Fixed032 routing uses internal methods/PIN only, original per-entry budgets, canonical worker messages and the existing 300-second worker ceiling. The seven suite processes retain 180-second individual limits.
Integrity corruption/restore and missing/restore checks stay within the same loader instance; reports from the main run were observed and their final 47/15 coverage independently recomputed.
notExecutedByReviewer: Main 977-per-target full regression and its independent-history/cycle suites were not rerun by this reviewer.
PostgreSQL integration, fresh package consumers, CI and v033 public download/install were not executed by this reviewer.
No new public archive was downloaded here; actual published032 provenance was checked through the supplied publication receipt, installed fixed PIN and matching retained anonymous component bytes.

This reviewer authored the compact loader implementation in an earlier development task; its implementation is not independently accepted by this review. The new routing/group integration and installed source bytes were reviewed here.
No performance measurement or model-composition implementation acceptance is included.
